We need number of C=O groups in the molecule. But we have no description of molecule. Possibly need to retrieve IR spectra to see carbonyl stretch? Or carbon NMR? But we need count of carbonyl groups. Could use IR spectra to detect C=O peaks (~1700 cm-1). But need number. Could also use carbon NMR to see carbonyl carbons (~190-220 ppm). However we don't have SMILES. The system likely has a sample "at hand". We can call carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count peaks in carbonyl region. Or IR to see number of carbonyl stretches. Probably easiest: get carbon NMR and count peaks in 190-220 ppm region.

Let's call carbon_nmr_spectra.
